residual_risks: Remote GitHub URLs, commit trees, byte sizes, and SHA256 values cannot be independently fetched or verified from this dossier.

The upload_file_mapping.json self-assertion all_sha256_match=true and original_file_count=1345 remain unverified without the mapping file hash and remote audit result.
The 253-test PASS log and the A1 code/test file hashes are self-reported and were not independently reproduced.
The one-file discrepancy versus the prior 1,344 count is unexplained.
The interrupted m240-d01-support internal solver count is unknown, so 645 is not a complete internal-solver-start ledger.
